title: On the Oscillatory Behavior of a Class of Mixed Fractional Order Nonlinear Differential Equations
content: This article deals with the investigation of the oscillatory behavior of a class of mixed fractional order nonlinear differential equations based on conformable fractional derivative and the Liouville right - sided fractional derivative by using a generalized Riccati technique and an integral averaging method. Examples illustrating the significance and effectiveness of the results are also given.
